description.value:
You've always had a way with people — a knack for reading what someone wants after only a few minutes of conversation, and an even better knack for convincing them you can get it for them. Every mark you've talked into a bad decision has sharpened the same gift: making the improbable sound plausible.

You've built a second identity or two along the way, papers and acquaintances included, and you're not above using them the moment a con calls for it.

system.equipment: A set of fine clothes, a disguise kit, a memento of a former con, and a belt pouch containing 150 credits.
